name: Bible Keep
description: Google Keep-style note-taking app with Bible verse insertion. Create text notes, auto-detect verse references (e.g. 'matt 5:12'), and fetch verses from API.Bible in NLT translation.
author: linuxbox
changelog: v0.5.11: fix verse detection on existing text when pressing Enter

name: Watch Battery Monitor
description: Monitors your Pixel Watch battery over BLE and automatically controls a TP-Link Kasa smart plug to manage charging. Set custom high/low thresholds — the plug turns on when battery drops and turns off when fully charged.
author: Kevin Driedger
changelog: v0.8.4: Fix background service not auto-starting after process death — service restarts automatically when app opens with a device selected

name: VibeStore
description: Your personal Android app store for vibe-coded apps. Hand-crafted. No corporate nonsense. Browse, discover, and download independently developed Android apps.
author: linuxbox
changelog: v1.0.4: Add Open button — launch installed apps by package name from detail screen

name: Twenty48
description: A modern Flutter Flame implementation of the classic 2048 puzzle game. Smooth tile animations, score tracking, and a sleek dark-mode UI with Flutter-inspired accents.
author: linuxbox

name: SheetApp
description: Convert spreadsheets (CSV/XLSX) into full Android apps. Multi-screen support with forms, lists, dashboards, and details. Rich native fields (photo, signature, GPS, barcode scan, graphs, links), live formulas, conditionals, local storage, Google Sheets sync, and standalone APK generator.
author: Kevin Driedger
changelog: v1.4.0: Minor version bump per project policy (bump second number after every feature). Includes UX improvements for multi-screen forms: added Save record button inside form steps (Back/Next navigation), New/Add Record now collects fields from all form screens. Fixed so multiple steps (e.g. Personal Info + Preferences) can be filled and persisted to list/dashboard views. Updated demo CSV and docs.

name: Vitaminder
description: A simple vitamin reminder app. Tap the star to log your vitamins and stay on track with your daily supplements.
author: Kevin Driedger
changelog: v1.2.19: fix NFC cold-start — tap once from home screen or screen off

name: 2048-Tetris
description: 2048 meets Tetris: one falling tile at a time. Slide left or right to merge matching numbers, reach the 2048 tile, and survive as the drop speed increases.
author: linuxbox
changelog: v0.1.0: First release — Flutter port of Prateek Agarwal's 2048-Tetris with swipe controls and difficulty levels
